stock.description: Eagle Nice (International) Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise focused on the manufacturing and global distribution of athletic wear and general garments. Its commercial activities span key markets including Mainland China, the United States, Europe, Japan, and other international territories. The company's diverse product portfolio features various sportswear items such as down jackets, tracksuits, sweaters, and sports trousers. Established in 1993, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
